transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable inherent `Vec<T, A>::as_mut_slice` method, adapting the signature to Verus named-return/lifetime syntax while preserving the Rust 1.96 data flow through `self.as_mut_ptr()`, `self.len`, and the unsafe aggregate_raw_ptr mutable-slice construction.
Reused the reviewed `Vec::as_mut_ptr` vocabulary (`CapacitySpec::spec_capacity` and `vec_start_mut_ptr`) for the raw start-pointer relation instead of assuming the public target postcondition.

Modeled only the source-backed intrinsic/raw-pointer/unsafe boundary for `&mut *core::intrinsics::aggregate_raw_ptr::<*mut [T], _, _>(self.as_mut_ptr(), self.len)`, carrying the exact copied vstd postconditions `slice@ == old(vec)@` and `final(slice)@ == final(vec)@`.
Public target remains non-external-body and contains no `assume_specification` marker.
